mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs and increased liquidity.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0% in 3 months, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and industrial production signal broad economic weakness, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: The HOUST-INDPRO decline interaction fails to generate negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% y/y) triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as higher rates dampen equity valuations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% y/y, or Rank IC for regime condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising payroll employment trend consistently indicates improving economic conditions, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate hiring supports revenue growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1,300,000 units annually signals weak consumer demand for durable goods, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as homebuilding slowdowns reduce economic activity.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST falls below 1300.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous inflation acceleration (CPIAUCSL rise) and labor market strength (UNRATE decline) signal an overheating economy that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The CPIAUCSL-UNRATE interaction fails to generate negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 105.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
